notes.title: Hotfix Update - Final Boss Issue Fixed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just released a hotfix update that fixes an issue where players [spoiler]could get stuck during the final boss fight after inserting the third module.[/spoiler]

🔹 Fixed: [spoiler]The final boss now properly defeats the player and correctly ends the attempt.[/spoiler]

A big thank you to "[i]Buy Bitcoin[/i]" for the bug report and testing!
If you encounter any further issues, let us know.

notes.title: The Wait is Over: The M.O.O.D.S. Holiday Update is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/701c46622d81301d7b14f159decef654e325a8ad.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your amazing support and patience! Today, we’re thrilled to unleash our [b]biggest update yet[/b]. Building on last week's sneak peek, here’s what you can dive into right now:

[h2]Boss Fight Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/a2af83b578a5e08dabde6ba1f59fd51d53b6d575.gif[/img]
[list] 
[*] [b]Many Bosses upgraded [/b]: From the smallest quirks to their most devastating attacks, bosses now feel more alive than ever. All first bosses have been fine-tuned, with more distinct reactions during conversations, which means new attacks and behaviors you've never seen before. The other bosses will follow soon!
[*] [b]Difficulty Settings [/b]: Players can now choose between 4 different difficulties, which can always be changed in the settings when you're in the base. Take it a bit more easy or really punish yourself, it's all up to you!
[/list]

[h2]Enhanced Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/1801ddddd6d531b1c7e90018f09a787c973ea21b.gif[/img]
[list] 
[*] [b]Enemy Overhaul[/b]: Adjusted enemy versatility, difficulty, and added new attacks.
[*] [b]Room Updates[/b]: Enhanced Pride, Anger, and Sorrow Rooms with better gameplay, navigation, sound, and performance. Added entirely new rooms!
[*] [b]Sound Improvements[/b]: New tracks, added reverb, and refined sound effects for weapons and shots.
[*] [b]Visual Upgrades[/b]: Improved colorization and style.
[*] [b]CPU Optimizations:[/b] Smoother performance.
[*] [b]Speech Bubbles[/b]: Enemies now comment on your behavior during battles.
[/list]

[h2]Fresh Content You’ll Love[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/0e02e9c1abece4675d73ccb8d567b8e8d0174835.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: Duality Rifle, Gluebomb Thrower, and True Shot Musket.
[*] [b]Add-Ins[/b]: Hullbreacher, Elemental Orb, Homing Swarm, Perfection, Overseeing, Bullet Pulse, and Add-In Add-Ins.
[*] [b]Abilities[/b]: 10 new inherent armor features.
[*] [b]Boss Fight[/b]: Face the first phase of the final boss—the ultimate showdown is coming soon!
[*] [b]New Quest Type[/b]: Bet with Syop for rewards (or face the mockery if you fail).
[*] [b]Intro Sequence[/b]: Beautifully revamped video to set the stage.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Polishing[/h2]
[list] 
[*] Major improvements to visual clarity in all areas.
[*] Fixed rare crashes during intense battles.
[*] Fixed various Add-In and weapon bugs.
[*] Improved save/load systems for smoother transitions.
[*] Squashed countless other bugs for a smoother experience.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=fdvfr2_IylQ;full][/previewyoutube]


🎁 Holiday Special Event: Don’t miss the festive chest in the base for free gifts—available for a limited time only!🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/930a44846231c606defc5006305ec1ff75073584.gif[/img]

As always, your feedback drives us to keep improving M.O.O.D.S. Let us know what you think of this update and what you’d love to see next. Your ideas help shape the world of M.O.O.D.S. 💖
🛠️Bug Reports: Found something odd? Report it here:🛠️
https://discord.com/invite/dfYQp8AEtv 
or directly report something to our dev team:
https://mantisbt.stickystonestudio.com/bug_report_page.php


Happy Holidays, and we’ll see you in the game!
– The M.O.O.D.S. Team

notes.title: First Major UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h3][b]► First Huge Update of M.O.O.D.S. Thank you all for the feedback and suggestions! Demo was also updated![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/3db6d789ff6d63a2a64701dd70351b98c298fa68.gif[/img]

[h2][b]⭐NEW⭐[/b][/h2]
► New Artstyle package and adjusted post-processing
► Achievements added to the game! (61 in total)
► Added AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution (FSR) Mode
► 🆕[b]3 Brand new Add-Ins[/b] for reload mechanics
► 🆕[b]New Weapon: Drone Strike Glove[/b]
► 🆕New Feature that helps with [b]finding Items with similar functions [/b]
► Rich Presence for Steam and Discord
► Added Korean localization
► Game-Settings can now be accessed via a JSON
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/7b6200539f6a07ad4667c287619b705bac98f0a7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/0d191f26c9a8351a8fc7fb9975ff4f2129c9ddca.gif[/img]

[h2][b]⚙️Changes⚙️[/b][/h2]
► Re-worked a lot of rooms for smoother gameplay
► Bosses now drop XP when taking damage (Abilities fuel)
► Weapons now automatically reload when you switch them
► All enemies no longer reflect bullets
► 'Wrath Repeater' has a new model
► New weapon sounds for many weapons
► Multiplayer difficulty scaling no longer boosts enemy damage
► Leotron the Loyalist: Upgraded model and reworked animations
► Economy adjustments: Armor is cheaper, weapon upgrades are more expensive
► Upgraded a lot of VFX and particles
► Balanced gameplay and stats for many Add-Ins
► Further Menu Enhancements: Numerous menus have been updated for improved UX and QoL.
► Optimization for CPU load
► Burn debuff on the player can now be extinguished by dashing


[h2][b]👾Bugfixes👾[/b][/h2]
► Fixed some issues in local multiplayer
► Fixed an issue with the tutorial splash screens
► Fixed a problem with Bounded Camera mode
► Fixed some bugs in the Shopkeeper punishment system
► Fixed a lot of other small issues and bugs!

notes.title: Steam Achievements, Upcoming plans, and new language support
notes.content:
[h3]Suggest your achievement![/h3]
We have already planned for 20+ Steam Achievements for the next update. If you want to add an achievement that will be forever in the game — suggest it here or in our [url=https://discord.gg/dfYQp8AEtv]Discord[/url].

[h3]Upcoming Plans[/h3]
As we received a lot of feedback related to the quality, the refracturing will be the major part of the upcoming update. Here are the details of what we are working on:
[list]
[*] Achievement system 
[*] Artstyle change
[*] Big new quest system
[*] Steam Rich Presence
[*] Player settings adjustments
[*] Leontron & Mitron refactor
[*] New addins
[*] FSR System (FPS unlocking for some graphic cards)
[/list]
+ As always, bugfixes, little tweaks, and improvements

[h3]New Language - Korean[/h3]
MOODS participates in [url=https://bicfest.org/exhibition/view/1350]BIC 2024 online showcase[/url], the biggest indie event in South Korea. For this event, we have added the Korean language. Also, if you want to vote for MOODS, please register to be able to click the like button:
>>>https://bicfest.org/exhibition/view/1350

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/4d1f98cc69108e2dbcd81afc7504f4625992aa2f.png[/img]

[h3]New Demo[/h3]
As we have taken down the Prologue, we re-worked balance and visuals a bit, and re-uploaded it as a new demo. The original demo had the issue causing vertigo, but now it can showcase the game's actual quality.

-StickyStoneStudio
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956770/MOODS/

notes.title: Day 1 Patchlog Version: 0.4.09.5449
notes.content:
Hello! We received the feedback about visuals, sounds and bugs. We are working on it. Here is the first patch for issues we could fix fast.
Please leave Steam review and share your thoughts with us!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- SkillTree Confirm Button now hidden if skill is already skilled
- Added new VFX for SecretRoom Choosemachine
- Orbiter is stronger now
- Ringer and Pinger champs have slower bullets now
- Joy Turret shoots slower
- Some final touches in the base

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
- Grids at Boss "Skorm, Karrdis & Wreg" now dropping correctly
- Sorrow Equipment now visible in Mechionary
- Thunderhawk now invisible during Dialogs
- Laser of Boss Valerie is doing damage again
- Reset XP display on Restart
- Reset player abilities on Restart
- Ability Sprite in Hud now updates correctly
- Collactables cant be skipped on room change
- Glitcher Addin now got a max bullet count
- Fixed Sorrow Chest possible hard stuck
- Fixed stuck in EscapeMenu Playerpanel after kicking Playerpanel
- Empty Revange Quest now hidden
- Addin fixes for Sorrow Enemies
- Fixed Sorrow Stage unlocking after collecting Anger Module 
- Fixed Lags with Mitron and Blackhole Addin
- Teleporter and Meteorizer now works on Enemies
- Thunderhawk now works on Enemies
- Default Language now is Steam client Language
- Fixed Urmog jumping into walls

►Added Japanese and Russian languages
►Upgraded all visuals of NPC houses on the Base

►Changed the active reload values for some weapons

►Fixed Multiplayer issue when re-joining a saved game
►Improved performance for several VFX

►Fixed some issues when opening multiple Menus at the same time
►Fixed UI issues in Multiplayer when displaying the ability status
►Anger Avatars killing themselves no longer locks the game

notes.title: FINAL COUNTDOWN UPDATE
notes.content:
This patch improves the overall visibility of the game, and performance and fixes a handful of the most pressing bugs. As always, [b]thank you SO MUCH for your reports and support![/b] 

If you encounter weird-looking animations and extreme performance issues, ensure your graphics driver doesn’t overwrite the framerate.
We will unlock the framerate in the future to support higher framerates!

[b]Visit OhRye channel on YT:[/b]

notes.title: 🥳 M.O.O.D.S. Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/cb4b69f295f784b928505ae4c9f51c082908142e.png[/img]

[h1]🥳 M.O.O.D.S. will be released on Steam Early Access on July 29th!🥳 [/h1]

[b]M.O.O.D.S.[/b], aka Mechanical Organisms on Destructive Substances. It is a [b]top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter[/b] where you [b]fight crazed robots with futuristic guns equipped with switchable addin modifications[/b]. A long time ago, humans left the Earth, and to become more like their creators, mechs implanted themselves with an Emotion Module to feel the moods people had experienced. It did not go well.

[h3][b]Four Years of Development in One Image[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/d3ebd7c2d71fc92c6ac28544e0342b19a98abf14.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Gameplay: [/h3][olist]
[*] [b]The main innovative part of the gameplay is short talks with Bosses before the battle[/b]. In games like Hades or Tiny Rogue boss dialogue is an essential part of world-building. But in M.O.O.D.S., the emotion you choose to answer with will affect how your next boss battle will go. Valery will be weakened by a sad or lovable answer, but she will add cryo to her bullets if your answer is fired with anger.
[*] [b]Addins modifications[/b] are another curious addition. You can [b]switch them at any time between the two weapons you carry[/b]. Some addins work better with one type of weapons, others will add some interesting effects in general, and some… are here just to bring chaos. For example, Acid Puddle Addin that leaves said puddles while bullets fly works best with fast-shooting weapons with many bullets in the magazine, like a Swarm Emitter or Arcblaster. But it is useless with sniper-type weapons. Psst! Never try Glitcher Addin —you have been warned.
[*] [b]Classes are presented with 5 Emotions[/b]: Joy that summons an auto-shooting turret, Pride that covers itself with a reflective shield, Love that charms enemies to fight on your side, Anger that increases your fire rate, and Sorrow with its taunting mech-dog. More curious are the upgrades for the class abilities. Like Anger’s upgrade to prolong ability effect time with each kill, making it an OP skill for otherwise challenging rooms.
[*] M.O.O.D.S. is more than a roguelike survivor-like game. Aside from [b]dungeon-crawler-like[/b] maps filled with enemies to shoot, you will find [b]NPCs with quests[/b], [b]secret and challenge rooms[/b], or enemies that run away and drop more cash when killed. There are elements of [b]base-building[/b], where you start in a lame flying junkyard and then [b]build workshops for your NPC friends[/b]. Also, there is a [b]shared-screen local co-op[/b] to play with friends on Steam or when someone crashes at your place.
[/olist]

[h3]Brand New Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=jMIINegXVb8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The Content Roadmap is coming soon![/i]

-StickyStone Studio

notes.title: Recent Updates - Accessibility, New Content, Upcoming Beta
notes.content:
Hello! It is StickyStone Studios.
We want to share bits of what we were working on after the Prologue release!

[h2]Accessibility - Bullet Colors[/h2]
One of the feedback we have received a lot was [b]unconventional projectile colors[/b]. Some even said that [b]the bullet colors of char and enemies were swapped[/b], making it difficult to get used to the game at first.
During our deep dive into the topic, we found out that there are [b]300 million color-blind people[/b] in the world, with every [b]1 out of 12 men having it to a certain extent[/b].

[h3][i]Johnny - I told you guys, it is magenta! Not pink![/i][/h3]

98% of color blindness is in red-green zone, meaning 1/12 players could not play Anger char in the Pride Region. [b]So we fixed this:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/8a39a78051114bae014aa5014b0290e1e93e2f3e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/fd51847e8bedb289d695cb156de0e40229befd04.gif[/img]

[h3]Not only char colors! You can pick the enemy bullet color too![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/8056bfab504501eab40c9656471a4c273537ae99.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/0e7ce3066b6b021b73d1e05c3d4dcdb42f2df49e.gif[/img]

[h2]New Content - New Region & Char[/h2]
[h3]Now there are 3 regions — Pride, Anger, and Sorrow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/434848b1c716f0303e25412832e1df5898256f43.png[/img]
For the Sorrow region, The Silent Ruins, we have chosen an urban design. As the main topic of the lore is about humans leaving robots behind, this whole region is about the reminiscence of the once most populated places mech's creators used to live in.

Currently, we are working on making environments more visually readable and harmonic. As well as filling it with more content.

[h3]More unique enemies[/h3]
Mechs in the Sorrow Region are more technologically advanced and are much more disciplined, making them more fierce than any foe you have met before.

[b]Chargers - shine red before ramming you[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/3aed16ff9a0b8720dab51a51f4f35da58fa0ce3d.png[/img]
[b]Enemy Projection - weakened holograms[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/cf7801993cf6368668f8aff20df90c029374f98d.png[/img]
[b]Icy Demolisher - Freeze arrow across the map[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/8b01a7e9b8df6812ac7fdacd8b4f753bc162c538.png[/img]
[h2]Upcoming Beta - The list is almost decided[/h2]
If you consider joining, submit your request here. If someone decides not to participate, we will call you : )
https://forms.gle/6HjBZn3fWpva4JdT7

[url=https://discord.gg/dfYQp8AEtv]Join our Discord[/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956770/MOODS

- StickyStone Studios

notes.title: M.O.O.D.S. is coming to Gamescom 2022!
notes.content:
Good day, fellow moody mechs!

We're back to announce a very special event [b]M.O.O.D.S.[/b] is showing up to...

[h1][b]It's Gamescom![/b][/h1]

You can either meet us [b]in person[/b] in Cologne or just [i][b]play the Demo[/b][/i] [b]at home[/b] in the [b]Steam Gamescom 2022 event![/b]

You'll be able to discover M.O.O.D.S. all over again, as we have added a plethora of things to explore since last Demo. There is also [b]LOCAL MULTIPLAYER[/b] now, so you can enjoy the game at home with your friends!

[h3][u]Other new things:[/u][/h3]
- A bunch of new Weapon Addins!
- A huge amount of new Equipment Abilities
- New classes
- A new boss
- A new Tutorial level
- A brand-new [b]home base[/b] with new NPCs
- MoodsME AI-powered emotional webcam scanner
- Plenty of gameplay improvements & bugfixes

If you want to pay us a visit in person, come on down to
Hall 10.2, Booth E-010g-D-021g at #IAHoI

We hope to see you at [b]Gamescom[/b] and thank you for your continued support!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/60cf9cf3912ff064fdbc5fd7e59b612abaff2cb4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch Notes v0.2.15[/h1]

Good day, fellow mech enthusiasts!

We hope you're continuing to enjoy your Demo of [b]M.O.O.D.S.[/b]!
We have just deployed a new version with a brand new ability to find, balance changes to explore and plenty of bugfixes.

Be sure to fill out this [b][url=https://www.stickystonestudio.de/goto/moods-survey/]Survey[/url][/b] if you have any feedback/criticism after playing!

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
► New Equipment Ability: Revenger

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
► Items now have a more unanimous pricing in shops
► Increased Secret Room max time
► Increased Dash invulnerability duration
► Multi-Champions cannot scale to infinity anymore
► Boss Leotron no longer reflects instantly after leaving his screw

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
► Fixed enemies shooting after death
► Fixed dash stopping short at bridges
► Fixed the Inventory GScrap Multiplier resetting after a stage change
► Fixed explosion indicators displaying an incorrect radius
► Fixed getting an incorrect amount of GScrap from chests
► Fixed shops not closing after attacking nearby destructibles
► Fixed softlocking while opening Steam Overlay and Inventory at the same time
► Fixed some Equipment abilities not displaying a sprite in the Inventory Info page
► Fixed shop closing automatically after buying one item
► Fixed fonts displaying boxes around themselves
► Fixed Pride Shield ability reflecting twice
► Fixed Pride Shield displaying room shadows multiple times
► Fixed chests not opening properly after Splash Screens
► Fixed Leonides reflecting after death
► Fixed player ability never turning off after leveling up
► Fixed Sp00derBombers not glowing when spawning outside of FoV

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.2.13
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/57685455e788ade0d25915588495298b4fac06b5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes v0.2.13[/h1]

Good day, fellow mech enthusiasts!

We hope everyone is enjoying their demo of [b]M.O.O.D.S.[/b]!
A new version just got deployed with new features to explore and plenty of bugfixes.
We're looking forward to reading your feedback and are excited to see your reactions to the changes!

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
► Boss Leotron now displays his phases as shields on his health bar
► Improved enemy AI
► Multiple items can now be bought from the shop
► Renamed a bunch of Equipment abilities:
[list]
[*]Shield ► Orbiting Shield
[*]Damage Aura ► Vortex Aura
[*]Faster Shield Recharge ► Boosted Actuators
[*]More Damage On Shield Hit ► Enhanced Shield Receptors
[*]More Damage On Hit ► Enhanced Pain Receptors
[*]More Damage vs Bosses ► Anti-Boss Projectiles
[*]More Enemy Scraps ► Scrap-Tuned Radar
[*]More Enemy XP ► RAM Allocator
[*]Puddle ► Acidic Trail
[*]Reflect Bullets ► Mistuned Reflector
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
► Removed Turbine Dash from Boots equipment slot
► Boss Leotron now only has 3 phases (down from 4)
► Buffed Vortex Aura[list]
[*]Lv. 1[list]
[*]Common: 4-6 ► 6-8
[*]Uncommon: 5-7 ► 8-10
[*]Rare: 6-8 ► 10-12
[*]Epic: 7-8 ► 12-14
[*]Legendary: 8-10 ► 14-16
[*]Range: 3[/list]
[*]Lv. 2[list]
[*]Common: 6-8 ► 8-10
[*]Uncommon: 7-9 ► 10-12
[*]Rare: 8-10 ► 12-14
[*]Epic: 9-11 ► 14-16
[*]Legendary: 10-12 ► 16-18
[*]Range: 3 ► 4[/list][/list]
► Nerfed Enhanced Shield Receptors[list]
[*]Lv. 1[list]
[*]Common: +1%-3% ► +1-2%
[*]Uncommon: +4%-6% ► +2-3%
[*]Rare: +7%-9% ► +3-4%
[*]Epic: +10%-15% ► +5-6%
[*]Legendary: +16%-20% ► +8-10%
[*]Max: +150% ► +75%[/list]
[*]Lv. 2[list]
[*]Common: +2%-5% ► +2-4%
[*]Uncommon: +6%-10% ► +3-5%
[*]Rare: +11%-15% ► +4-6%
[*]Epic: +16%-20% ► +6-8%
[*]Legendary: +21%-25% ► +10-12%
[*]Max: +200% ► +100%[/list][/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
► Fixed Inventory Stats panel displaying wrong values after starting a new game
► Fixed Sleight of Hand ability resetting too much after a stage change
► Fixed Bullseye Addin shop price
► Fixed Leonide shield reflecting instantly
► Fixed several UI menu bugs
► Fixed Blazecannon VFX after changing weapons
► Fixed menu confirm with mouse
► Fixed room magnet trap not rotation properly
► Fixed Player Level & XP getting reset in UI on map change
► Fixed mouse not working with touch displays
► Fixed boss ragdoll not disappearing after entering Map Selector
► Fixed some collisions on destructibles and level elements
► Fixed a softlock that could occur when immediately opening inventory after looting a chest
► Fixed other menu problems
► Castle Shop can now more easily be accessed
► Ion-Drive Rifle can now be reloaded properly after its burstfire
► Adjusted Options navigation with controller to allow for easier navigation

Thank you for your continued support and we hope you'll continue having fun with the [b]Going Rogue[/b] event!

- 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙎𝙩𝙞𝙘𝙠𝙮𝙎𝙩𝙤𝙣𝙚𝙎𝙩𝙪𝙙𝙞𝙤 𝙩𝙚𝙖𝙢
